messages:
ellie (People Ops): Hey all 0  quick share: we've assembled a tiny 'Goal Evidence Checklist' to help ICs prep self-reviews and help managers give fast, consistent feedback. It's intentionally minimal (3 rows max). Link: https://go.redwood/gev-checklist (view).
brad (Eng): Nice  Is this meant for every KR or just the ones we care most about?
mina (PM): Recommend: add for top 3 KRs. Keeps friction low and captures the most important signals for calibrations.
ellie (People Ops): Exactly. Required fields: one-line evidence, date, artifact link (PR/dash/ticket), evidence type (metric/qual/incident), and a one-sentence method note. Optional: customer impact line.
samir (Manager): Can we get paste-ready manager comments? saves time and keeps tone consistent.
ellie (People Ops): Yup, three micro-phrases in the doc you can paste: 
- Praise: "Nice: dated artifact + link. Could you add the experiment/PR ID for traceability?"
- Clarify: "Thanks  can you add sampling window and segmentation used for the metric?"
- Growth: "Strong start; add a customer example or scale metric to strengthen the case."
brad (Eng): Thinking automation: could we auto-detect PR links and surface them?
ellie (People Ops): We're exploring auto-link parsing for the template. For pilot please paste links manually.
mina (PM): Cadence Q: live updates vs snapshot at check-ins?
checkin-bot: Reminder: Mid-cycle check-ins open 2026-04-15. People Ops recommends ongoing updates; we'll snapshot on check-in date.
samir (Manager): I'll ask my team to add at least one evidence row for each of their top 3 KRs by next Friday.
ellie (People Ops): Awesome  thanks. If any team wants a 10-min walkthrough, DM me and I can join your sync. :thumbsup:
